title: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30406v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. translated_title: TAP：扩散语言模型的策略接口
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过对掩码画布进行去噪来生成文本，这使其成为进行选择性生成决策（如回答、等待、澄清或拒绝）的天然场景。我们提出了 TAP-DiLM，它在掩码扩散语言模型中引入了一个带类型的策略变量，并研究了该策略应如何附加到去噪过程上。我们在 BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B 和 Dream-7B 等模型上，比较了共享词表槽位、专用槽位头以及基于 CLS 的外部头三种方案。结果揭示了明显的接口与骨干之间的交互效应：专用头在各种规模下都能提供稳健的策略学习，而共享词表头在 LM 头几何结构有利时也能有效发挥作用。一个简单的 LM 头尖锐度探针可以预测共享头策略内化何时可靠，为接口选择提供了实用的诊断手段。因果钳制与槽位注入测试表明，专用策略槽位能够通过反馈影响主体去噪过程，尤其在（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出TAP-DiLM，在掩码扩散语言模型中引入带类型的策略变量，系统比较了专用槽位头、共享词表槽位和CLS外部头等策略接口的优劣，并给出基于LM头尖锐度的实用接口选择诊断方法。
en_tdlr: TAP-DiLM introduces a typed policy variable into masked diffusion language models, systematically compares policy interfaces (dedicated slot heads vs. shared-vocabulary slots vs. CLS-based external heads), and provides a practical LM-head sharpness probe for selecting the right interface.
